seoDescription: Our privacy and data protection notice details how FilmEditRun processes project inquiries, respects your privacy, and complies with the UK GDPR and Data (Use and Access) Act 2025.
heading: Privacy & Cookie Policy
introText: FilmEditRun is committed to respecting your privacy, protecting your personal data, and maintaining transparency about how we handle information. This policy sets out our data processing practices for visitors, clients, and prospective clients in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018 (DPA 2018), and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (DUAA).

sections.title: Data Controller & Contact Information
sections.content:
For the purposes of UK data protection law, the Data Controller is:

**FilmEditRun**  
Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, CB1 2JW, United Kingdom  
Telephone: +44 1223 926450  
Email: contact@filmeditrun.co.uk  
Website: https://filmeditrun.co.uk

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, your rights, or our handling of your personal data, please contact our data compliance desk using the email above.

sections.title: What Personal Data We Collect
sections.content:
We only collect personal information that is necessary to communicate with you and evaluate your creative project requirements. This includes:

* **Identity & Contact Details:** Your first name, surname, and professional email address submitted through our project brief form.
* **Project Requirements:** The services you request (e.g. filming, editing, full production, motion graphics) and the details, dates, visual references, and location information provided in your project brief.
* **Client Communications:** Any follow-up correspondence, meeting notes, creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards shared during our discovery and quoting discussions.
* **Technical Metadata:** Minimal non-identifying server headers (such as browser user-agent and timestamp) generated automatically when accessing our website.

sections.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
sections.content:
Under Article 6 of the UK GDPR and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (DUAA), we rely on the following lawful grounds:

* **Steps Prior to Entering into a Contract (Article 6(1)(b)):** When you submit a project brief via our website, processing your contact details and requirements is necessary for us to review your scope and provide a tailored commercial proposal.
* **Performance of a Contract (Article 6(1)(b)):** If you commission FilmEditRun, processing your information is necessary to deliver our video production, cinematography, editing, and mastering services.
* **Recognised Legitimate Interests (Article 6(1)(f) & DUAA 2025):** We have a legitimate commercial interest in responding to incoming business inquiries, preventing fraud, maintaining website security, and communicating with commercial clients about our production capabilities.

sections.title: Third-Party Data Processors & Infrastructure
sections.content:
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We only share information with trusted technical service providers who act as data processors under strict confidentiality and security agreements:

* **Form Ingestion & Delivery:** We use FormTorch to securely receive and route contact form submissions to our production inbox.
* **Security & Bot Prevention:** We use Cloudflare Turnstile to verify that form submissions are from human visitors and protect our infrastructure against automated abuse.
* **Video Portfolio Hosting:** We showcase video work using Vimeo embeds. Video embeds on our site are loaded with the privacy-enhancing `dnt=1` (Do Not Track) parameter enabled to suppress third-party advertising tracking.

sections.title: Cookies & Local Storage (Zero-Tracking Policy)
sections.content:
FilmEditRun adheres to a strict privacy-first architecture. **We do not use advertising, marketing, or cross-site profiling cookies.**

* **Local Storage:** Our site uses browser `localStorage` solely to remember your chosen visual theme preference (Dark Noir, High-Key Light, or Supernova). Under Regulation 6 of the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) as amended by the DUAA 2025, storage used solely for user-requested interface appearance is explicitly exempt from cookie consent banner requirements.
* **Typography:** All website fonts are self-hosted directly on our servers. No connections are made to third-party font networks, ensuring your IP address is not logged by external providers.
* **No Consent Banner Needed:** Because we do not drop non-essential tracking cookies, our site does not display an intrusive cookie banner, allowing for an uninterrupted cinema viewing experience.

sections.title: Data Retention Periods
sections.content:
We only retain personal data for as long as is necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected:

* **Uncommissioned Inquiries:** If you submit a brief that does not proceed to a commission, your inquiry data is securely archived and deleted within 12 months.
* **Commissioned Projects:** For active production clients, contractual agreements, project communications, and invoices are retained for 6 years in accordance with UK statutory financial and tax obligations.
* **Raw Footage & Rushes:** Video rushes and working project files are archived according to individual commercial production agreements.

sections.title: Your Statutory Rights Under UK GDPR
sections.content:
Under UK data protection law, you possess key rights regarding your personal data:

* **Right of Access (Subject Access Request):** You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
* **Right to Rectification:** You can ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
* **Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten'):** You may request the deletion of your personal data where there is no compelling legal reason for its continued processing.
* **Right to Restriction & Objection:** You may request that we limit our processing or object to processing based on legitimate interests.

To exercise any of these rights, please email contact@filmeditrun.co.uk. We will respond within one calendar month without charge.

sections.title: DUAA 2025 Complaints Procedure & ICO Escalation
sections.content:
In accordance with the dispute resolution provisions of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (DUAA):

1. **Direct Complaint to FilmEditRun:** If you have concerns about our handling of your data, please contact our compliance desk at contact@filmeditrun.co.uk. Under DUAA 2025, we maintain an established internal complaints process and will acknowledge and investigate your complaint within 30 days.

2. **Escalation to the Supervisory Authority:** If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the UK supervisory authority:

**Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)**  
Wycliffe House, Water Lane, Wilmslow, Cheshire, SK9 5AF  
Telephone: 0303 123 1113  
Website: https://ico.org.uk
